book.name: Ephesus
book.title: Paul Letta Ta Dem Een Ephesus

content: De Chullun an Dey Fada an Modda
Chullun, ebry one ob oona mus do wa ya fada an modda tell ya fa do, cause dat de right ting fa do.
Een all de Law wa God gii Moses, de fus one wa got a promise long wid um say, “Ya mus gii hona ta ya fada an ya modda.”
De promise wa go long wid um say, “So dat all ting wa happen ta ya gwine be good fa ya an ya gwine lib a long time yah een de lan.”
Oona wa fada, mus dohn say an do ting ta oona chullun wa gwine mek um bex. Steada dat, oona mus laan um de Christian way.
De Massa an E Slabe
Oona wa slabe, oona mus show hona ta oona massa an do wa dey tell oona fa do. Mus do de wok wid all oona haat like oona beena do um fa Christ.
Mus dohn do oona wok good jes wen oona massa da watch oona, jes so dat dey gwine praise oona. Bot cause oona a slabe ob Christ, oona mus do wa God wahn wid all oona haat.
Oona mus do good wok wid heppy haat like oona da do um fa Christ, an not jes fa people.
Cause oona know fa sho dat Christ gwine gii ebrybody e pay fa de good wok dat e do. Ain mek no neba mind ef dat one a slabe or ef e free.

Oona wa massa, oona mus treat oona slabe dem een dat same good way. Mus dohn mek um scaid, da tell um how haad oona gwine be on um. Cause oona mus dohn neba fagit dat oona an oona slabe dem blongst ta de same Massa een heaben. An e ain gwine treat one poson mo betta den noda.
De Cloes Dat God Gii Oona fa de Fight
Leh me tell oona dis las wod. Oona mus leh de Lawd mek oona scrong an gii oona e mighty powa.

Oona mus pit on all dat God got fa protec oona wen oona fight ginst ebil, jes like sodja dem pit on dey iron cloes fa protec all dey body. Oona mus do dat so dat wen de Debil come wid e ebil scheme, oona gwine be able fa stanop ginst um.

Cause we ain da fight ginst people yah. We da fight ginst dem powa wa we ain able fa see, de ebil sperit dem high op dey. We da fight ginst de scrong powa dem wa da rule oba people wa ain bleebe pon God, wa got tority now een dis daak time we da lib een.

So den, oona mus pit on all dat God got fa protec oona een de fight, so dat wen de day come dat ebil come ta oona fa true, oona gwine be able fa stanop an fight ginst all de ebil scheme ob de Debil. An long as de enemy come ginst oona, oona gwine keep on da fight um. Oona gwine still stanop ginst um.

So den, mus stanop scrong ginst de Debil. Leh all wa true be like de belt wa oona fasten roun oona wais. An leh de right way oona da do, be like de iron plate wa oona da weah fa kiba oona chest fa protec oona wen oona da fight.
An leh de Good Nyews bout de peace wa God gii keep oona da stan scrong, like de shoe oona da weah pon oona foot.
Fodamo, leh oona trus een Christ be like a shield dat oona cyaa. Dis shield yah gwine protec oona, so dat all de bunin arrow dem wa de mos ebil one da shoot ain gwine do nottin ta oona.
Oona mus leh de sabation dat God gii protec oona like a helmet wa oona da weah pon oona head. An leh de wod ob God, wa de Holy Sperit gii oona, be like a sode fa fight ginst de enemy.
Pray all de time an aks God fa hep ya. Aks God Sperit fa hep ya pray. Mus dohn neba gii op. Pray all de time fa all God people.
An oona mus pray fa me too, dat God gwine show me wa A oughta say wensoneba A staat fa taak, so dat A ain gwine be scaid wen A tell people bout de Good Nyews ob Christ, dat dey ain know.
Fa de sake ob dis Good Nyews, A God messenja yah een chain een de jailhouse. Oona mus pray fa me so dat A ain gwine be scaid fa tell people bout Jedus Christ jes de way A oughta tell um.
Paul Las Wod Dem een Dis Letta
Tychicus, we deah Christian broda, e a faitful woka fa de Lawd. E gwine tell oona ebryting bout me, so dat oona gwine know how A da do an wa A da do.
Dat hoccome A da sen um ta oona, so dat e kin tell oona how we da do, an e gwine courage oona wid e wod.
A pray dat God we Fada an de Lawd Jedus Christ gii peace ta all de Christian bredren, an dat dey fait een Jedus Christ mek um all lob one noda.
An A pray dat God bless all dem wa lob we Lawd Jedus Christ wid lob wa ain neba gwine end.
